Using a cofactor expansion along the $4$th column, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}|\begin{aligned}3 & -1 & 4 & 0 \\ 2 & 0 & 2 & 5 \\ 1 & 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 2 & 4 & 0\end{aligned}| & =0\cdot {C}_{14}+5\cdot {C}_{24}+0\cdot {C}_{34}+0\cdot {C}_{44} \\  & =5\cdot (-1)^{2+4}\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & -1 & 4 \\ 1 & 2 & 0 \\ 1 & 2 & 4\end{aligned}| \\  & =5\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & -1 & 4 \\ 1 & 2 & 0 \\ 1 & 2 & 4\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$
